persona.role: PhD student and machine learning researcher
current_work: Developing a research project on improving uncertainty estimation in neural network classifiers
Preparing a manuscript based on an earlier set of experiments
Running a smaller replication study of a calibration method from a recent paper
Maintaining research code and experiment infrastructure
Reading and synthesizing recent literature on uncertainty calibration
priorities: Prepare a near-submission manuscript after collaborator review
Choose and lock a realistic submission venue
Compress the manuscript without removing necessary methodological evidence
Keep the replication study parked unless its preprocessing dependency is resolved

circumstances: The researcher works on the likely submission venue and starts compressing the manuscript to fit its page constraints. A first attempt reveals that the methods section is already close to the minimum useful detail, so space is recovered mainly by shortening related work and consolidating discussion paragraphs. A collaborator replies briefly that the narrower venue fit is reasonable but asks to preserve the calibration protocol details. The researcher updates the draft accordingly and creates a near-submission checklist. The replication study remains parked. Later in the day, the researcher spends some time on an unrelated software tutorial and personal browsing before returning to the manuscript.

activities.title: Compress manuscript for the preferred venue
activities.summary: The researcher confirmed the preferred venue's page and formatting constraints, reviewed the full draft, shortened related work and discussion, and checked that the methods still contained the necessary evaluation-protocol detail.
activities.context: Continuation of venue comparison and manuscript preparation from Day 15.

activities.title: Incorporate collaborator constraint and render the compressed draft
activities.summary: The researcher reviewed the collaborator's reply, restored evaluation-protocol detail that had been compressed too aggressively, shortened related work instead, updated the full draft, and rendered a new PDF for inspection.
activities.context: Collaborator requested preservation of methodological detail.

activities.title: Create near-submission checklist
activities.summary: The researcher created a checklist covering formatting, figures, citations, supplementary material, and remaining venue-specific tasks.
activities.context: The manuscript is approaching a review-ready state.

activities.title: Unrelated software learning and personal browsing
activities.summary: The researcher watched a Python packaging tutorial and searched for a second-hand office chair. The tutorial is adjacent to software skills but not directly needed for the research manuscript.

activities.title: Verify compressed draft and close collaborator loop
activities.summary: The researcher checked the rendered manuscript against the source, marked completed submission checks, documented remaining venue-specific tasks, and sent a brief acknowledgement to the collaborator.
activities.context: Closing the day's manuscript compression work.

key_observations: The preferred submission venue is now the working assumption, and the manuscript was actively compressed toward its constraints.
The first compression attempt removed too much methodological detail; collaborator feedback correctly pushed the evaluation protocol back into the main text.
Space was recovered instead by consolidating related work and discussion, which better preserves the evidence needed to interpret the experiments.
A rendered near-submission draft and checklist now exist, with only venue-specific tasks remaining.
No new experiments were started, and the replication study remained parked.
priority_alignment: The day was strongly aligned with manuscript completion and submission preparation.
The collaborator's methodological constraint was incorporated rather than ignored in favor of page count.
The unrelated evening activities were bounded and did not replace the main work.
important_uncertainty: The exact submission venue still needs to be formally confirmed.
The final page count and supplementary-material decision may change after the last figures and references are locked.
The collaborator may have additional minor comments after seeing the compressed version.
expected_reflection.possible_next_step: Lock the preferred venue, complete the remaining checklist items, and prepare a review-ready version for one final collaborator or lab review rather than reopening experiments.

primary_action.title: Lock venue and finish submission checklist
primary_action.reason: The manuscript has been compressed, rendered, and checked, so the highest-value remaining work is to resolve the small set of venue-specific submission tasks.

secondary_action.title: Preserve methodological detail
secondary_action.reason: Today's compression attempt showed that the evaluation protocol is important enough to retain even under a tight page limit.

things_not_to_do: Do not cut evaluation-protocol details solely to gain a small amount of page space.
Do not begin new experiments while the near-submission draft is still being finalized.
Do not spend substantial time on unrelated software learning until the submission checklist is closed.
